name: github-runner-pool
description: A pool of GitHub Actions runners in one virtual machine (Debian 13 cloud image; 16 CPUs, 32GiB, 200GiB). A slot runs one job on a fresh just-in-time runner (actions/runner 2.338.2, by digest) with its own Docker daemon (docker 29.9.3-dind, by digest), then replaces it. In a copy of this template set settings.url and settings.runnerGroupId (a dedicated runner group; the default is refused). Created stopped: set GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, or GITHUB_TOKEN, then instance_start.
